brief.t: START HERE: Call Sam and Ron to confirm Talova’s safety approver and authorized recovery method.

ACT NOW 1: Talova — splash reported 10 days ago. Safe-method approval, trial evidence and suspect-unit disposition remain unverified in reviewed sources. Send internally: Sam, Ron and Aaron, please name the approver and record the safe recovery method, trial results and suspect-unit disposition today before affected-method reuse or a completion promise.

ACT NOW 2: Roon — revised November 17 trial is 4 days away. Josh now recaps a 3 PM visit, 150 units per scent plus 5 kg bulk, with the 10K run moved to the week of December 1 and shipment by December 4. Acticire is scheduled to ship November 19; trial stock, sanitation and capper readiness need proof. The 5 kg allocation basis needs confirmation. Send internally: Michael, Evelyn and Aaron, please reconcile Josh’s revised November 17 scope against released stock, sanitation and capper readiness today, then confirm the achievable trial and December schedule before we accept it.

ACT NOW 3: Heritage — shipment request is 3 days old. Joseph’s November 11 urgent callback remains unclosed in reviewed sources; his claim that a PO is waiting on the dock still needs verification. Send internally: Sam and Steve, please identify Joseph’s Heritage PO, verify stock, QC and shipping readiness, and give him a callback today before promising dispatch.

next: Recommendation: Resolve safety and the revised Roon trial gates today; use the 10:30 Halls visit to pin down water readiness, not just installation.
